Count fragments in fixed-width genome tiles

RunGenomeTiles.Rd

Generate non-overlapping genome tiles and delegate sparse fragment counting to RecountATAC. No peak universe is required to define tiles; the source assay provides fragment mappings and reference provenance.

Usage

RunGenomeTiles(object, assay = NULL, seqlengths = NULL, chromosomes = NULL,
  bin.size = 5000L, cells = NULL, new.assay = NULL, process_n = 2000L,
  max.tiles = 2000000L, verbose = TRUE)

Arguments

object

Seurat object with validated ChromatinAssay and fragments.

assay

Source assay; NULL selects active assay.

seqlengths

Named positive integer reference lengths, or NULL to use known assay lengths. Supplied lengths must agree with known source lengths.

chromosomes

Optional unique contigs in output order.

bin.size

Positive integer tile width; last tile per chromosome is truncated.

cells

Source-assay cells; see RecountATAC.

new.assay

Unused assay name for writeback; NULL returns a list.

process_n

Native FeatureMatrix chunk size.

max.tiles

Positive upper bound on tile count before allocation.

verbose

Whether to print progress messages.

Value

RecountATAC's return value with tile parameters in its receipt. Counts are overlapping fragment records, not insertion endpoints or unique fragments across bins. A fragment crossing a boundary can count in both bins.
